source: same prepared real study snapshot used by the frozen NMF model
selection: Sort training document IDs by SHA256 of seed=42 concatenated with ID; first min(2000, eligible training count). Preserve selected IDs privately and publish only their hash/count.
comparability: Fit NMF and BERTopic on the same selected real training documents and preparation; do not compare subset BERTopic against full-corpus NMF as equivalent.
embedding_precondition: Local encoder with model/revision/hash/license manifest and frozen encoding settings; no corpus sent to external APIs. Missing encoder or compatible dependencies means blocked, not failed quality.
metrics: coherence with identical definition and term count
elapsed time and process peak memory
restore and transform held-out documents without refitting
stop_rule: Record resource/dependency failures and all configurations. Do not expand before inspecting the bounded training benchmark. Any expansion requires a new version of the protocol before execution.
adoption: Document quality, coverage, stability, resources and compatibility. No promise that BERTopic wins; preserve NMF if evidence is insufficient. Topic metrics alone do not establish forecast accuracy, XAI fidelity or human usefulness.
human_validation: Technical topic review is separate from sessions with real users. Neither is claimed by this protocol.
